name: aether-api-studio
description: Next-gen 3D interactive full-stack API testing studio — React Three Fiber, Express 5, Prisma 7.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
